mentalModel.expectation: A dense social network organised around people, feed units, conversations, discovery, short video, and a service menu.
mentalModel.naturalProducts: Products whose value improves through identity, social graph, publication, response, and repeated contribution.
mentalModel.conflicts: A private utility, one-shot tool, or passive catalogue must not borrow VK chrome unless its own core model maps to social identity and contribution.

compositionCatalog.root: VKRootSurface with one VKTabHeader and content owning the white top safe area
compositionCatalog.feed: ScrollView/LazyVStack of VKAuthoredPost separated only by GroupGap
compositionCatalog.post: VKAuthoredPost keeps author, content and VKPostActions in one semantic and visual block
compositionCatalog.push: VKNavigationChrome with one predictable back action and no automatic glass toolbar
compositionCatalog.modal: VKModalChrome plus native Form or ScrollView; one primary completion action
compositionCatalog.list: VKGroup with VKRow or VKPersonRow and RowSeparator; chevrons only for navigation
compositionCatalog.messages: Conversation rows open their own chat; VKChatHeader and keyboard-safe composer
compositionCatalog.profile: One profile entry point, VKGroup hierarchy and no duplicate avatar in the current root
compositionCatalog.permission: Contextual product action, real system prompt, then VKInlineNotice fallback

prohibitedComposition: decorative tabs or filters without distinct content and tested selection state
colored icon placeholder or decorative gradient
duplicate profile affordances on one root surface
glass back button inside VK content chrome
arbitrary card stack on a white social feed
thin functional icons below semibold optical weight
button or chevron without a deterministic destination or mutation
